_readme: Featured Instagram posts. Add one by pasting the permalink from the app (Share → Copy link), dropping the thumbnail into src/assets/posts/, and filling in the country slug. A post without a permalink still shows on its country page but stays out of the running index, because that list is only useful if every row goes somewhere.
